name: visual-sentinel
description: Website monitoring from your AI assistant. Visual Sentinel catches pages that look broken even when the site is up. Five tools work with no account (DNS lookup, SSL certificate inspection, speed test, website check, service health); twelve account tools need a Visual Sentinel API key, which comes with every paid plan, including the 10-day free trial.

VS_API_KEY.title: Visual Sentinel API key (optional)
VS_API_KEY.description: Only needed for the twelve account tools (every paid plan, including the 10-day free trial). Create one at https://visualsentinel.com/settings/api-keys. The five public tools work without it.
